notes: Thursday 'What's in your stack' post #2 (Autodesk Construction Cloud, renamed Autodesk Forma in March 2026; Autodesk Build is now Forma Build). Category Tech stack. Every Autodesk claim comes from Autodesk's own pages checked Nov 26, 2026: the rename post, the Cost Management Compliance Requirements help page (current version under manage-documents-in-cost), the GCPay integration help page, the TradeTapp overview, the BuildingConnected qualification post and the pricing page. Names no COI vendors and no GC's stack. The thing none of the competing pages has: the split between document-based and condition-based compliance requirements, which item types each attaches to, which blocks can be overridden and which can't, and the TradeTapp insurance condition that blocks sending a contract.
